basis: Fast: non rotating Alloy 718 bar to AMS 5662 and 5663, qualification runs in parallel with commissioning. Central: 12 to 24 months furnace approval (industry review). Slow: rotating grades, ATI isothermal forging lead times over two years.
note: Boeing says qualifying an alternative source of titanium and aluminium products can take a year or more (a metal other than nickel, used as a lower bound for the order of magnitude). The 12 to 24 month furnace approval is an industry reviewer statement, not a logged source.
